title: Custom Football Player Running Sideways Comforter
description:
Transform your bedroom into the ultimate sports haven with this Custom Football Bedding Set from Jeminise. Perfect for football players, fans, and teams, this bedding set features a cool footballer design running with a ball. With customization options to add your own name and number, it makes a thoughtful and unique sports gift for boys, teens, or any dedicated football enthusiast in your life.

Key Features

  • Personalized Design: Features 2 custom text inputs to add your own personalized name and number for a truly unique look.
  • Soft & Cozy Feel: Made from 100% brushed polyester fabric that is soft, breathable, lightweight, and durable.
  • Versatile Options: Choose between a lightweight duvet cover with a hidden zipper closure or a cozy, all-in-one comforter filled with premium microfiber to prevent clumping.
  • Superior Craftsmanship: Environmental protection printing techniques ensure vibrant colors that hold dye and prevent fading, with fine stitching along the edges.
  • Available Sizes: Perfectly fits a variety of beds including US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), and US King (104" x 88").
  • Included Components: Each set includes 1 Duvet Cover (or Comforter) and optional matching pillowcases or flat sheet cover.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water on a gentle cycle; tumble dry on low heat for quick, fluffy results.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter Set
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Brushed Polyester
Selected Design Cool Footballer
Theme Football
Care Instructions Machine wash with cold water, Tumble dry on low heat, Iron on low/medium heat
Customization Yes (Name & Number)
